releases.release_notes: RosetteOS 1.0.0 Baseline Release with Modular Configs, Calibration-Preserving Migration & Buildroot 2026.02 LTS
releases.changelog:
• Native SWUpdate dual-slot A/B streaming upgrade system
• Modular printer configs (hardware/, macros/) & immutable user.cfg
• Non-destructive configuration migration preserving SAVE_CONFIG & PID tunes
• Official Mainsail macro suite integration across all profiles
• Kernel 6.6.157 PREEMPT with /sys/class/backlight device wrapper
• Buildroot 2026.02 LTS modernization and Dropbear SFTP server
• ustreamer webcam optimization with TCP_NODELAY and WiFi IRQ priority tuning
• Power-Loss Recovery (PLR) dual-generation state machine
